content:
## Descrição do dataset

Este dataset contém metadados como data de publicação, título, resumo e palavras-chave de todos os artigos sobre o Brasil no The New York Times. Desta forma, esse conjunto de dados possui informações sobre 79.599 notícias, desde 1851 até 2021.

## Estrutura de dados

O dataset está no formato JSON, estruturado conforme o exemplo abaixo:

```json
[
  {
    "createdAt": "1851-10-06T05:00:00+0000",
    "title": "Our Commerce with Brazil.",
    "abstract": "Trade between U.S. and",
    "keywords": [
      "Brazil"
    ],
    "printPage": "2"
  },
  {
    "createdAt": "1851-12-06T05:00:00+0000",
    "title": "LATEST INTELLIGENCE; By Telegraph to the New-York Times. The Southern Mall--Health of Mr. Clay-Later from Rio Janeiro and Brazil.",
    "abstract": "The Southern mail, as late as due, has arrived. The papers contain nothing of interest. The Washington Telegraph says that Mr. Clay continues quite ill, and without improvement.  ",
    "keywords": [],
    "printPage": "4"
  },
  {
    "createdAt": "1851-10-13T05:00:00+0000",
    "title": "The Captain General of Cuba.",
    "abstract": "Don JOSE DE LA CONCHA, the Captain General whose administration has fallen in these troubles times is by birth a Brazillas, the son of a General who espoused the patriotic cause in Brazil, and who was killed in the course of the struggle. There are three or four brothers CONCHA, I believe, one of whom has acquired great power and influence is Spain, and who has of course raised his family with himself.  ",
    "keywords": [],
    "printPage": "4"
  }
]
```

## Solicitar acesso

O acesso a este dataset pode ser solicitado através do [link](https://zenodo.org/record/5557795) na plataforma Zenodo.
title: Metadados de notícias históricas sobre o Brasil no The New York Times
description: 79.599 notícias sobre o Brasil publicadas no The New York Times (1851-2021).
